items.description:
Macpro Manufacturing Projects was founded in 1991 as a general engineering company based in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, manufacturing and repairing parts to customer drawings and specifications in both ferrous and non-ferrous steels as well as engineering plastics. Its CNC milling and turning handles both production runs and individual once-off jobs, backed by project control for fabrication, castings, pressings, forging and specialised welding.

The workshop also offers laser, water-jet, gas and plasma profile cutting, and extends into finishing services such as powder coating, hot-dip galvanising, zinc plating, chemical blackening, anodising, electroless nickel plating and gun coating, letting a part go from raw steel to a finished, coated component without changing suppliers. Operating from Rudolph Street in Sunderland Ridge, the company serves manufacturers needing either standard production runs or urgent breakdown parts machined to exact tolerances.

Master Maths Pretoria North is a maths tuition centre at Wonderpark Shopping Centre that has coached grade 4 to 12 learners since launching in January 2012, with lessons taught fully bilingually in English and Afrikaans. It runs standard extra maths lessons alongside short courses, focused exam revision and online lessons for learners who can't attend in person.

The centre also supports learners wanting to redo or improve a Grade 12 maths result, working with a team of trained tutors in a calm, structured setting rather than a large classroom. Based at the corner of Heinrich and Brits roads in Karenpark, Pretoria North, it suits learners needing focused, small-group support to build maths confidence ahead of exams or school assessments.

Matys Brands and Marketing is a print and branding studio in Erasmia offering digital printing, graphic design and branding, and signage and vinyl solutions including vehicle wrapping, alongside 3D printing and laser cutting for more technical jobs.

The studio also runs binding and finishing services and operates its own wallpaper and DTF (direct-to-film) transfer stores, giving it a wider product range than a typical sign shop, from branded stationery such as business cards and letterheads through to printed wall coverings. Based in Erasmia, Centurion, it suits businesses and individuals wanting design, printing and signage handled by one supplier rather than separate studios.

MC Design & Contracting is a people-centred, client-focused industrial engineering company that has worked on multidisciplinary projects since 1990, with its head office in Port Elizabeth and branch offices in Pretoria and Durban. It designs and installs industrial facilities, piping systems, and electrical systems and automation for sectors including automotive, chemical, food and beverage, and pharmaceutical manufacturing.

The company holds ISO 9001 certification and is a Level 4 B-BBEE contributor, reflecting a focus on structured, accredited project delivery rather than informal contracting work. From its Rosslyn branch, it serves Pretoria-area manufacturers needing integrated engineering facilities built and maintained by a single contractor across mechanical, electrical and piping disciplines.

McCormick Property Development (MPD) is a family-owned retail property developer established in 1983, specialising in building and developing shopping malls and centres across South Africa and further into Sub-Saharan Africa.

The company focuses on retail centres in under-serviced regional and community areas, positioning its developments as local economic hubs for the communities around them rather than purely as retail space aimed at larger metro markets. Its project pipeline spans both completed shopping centres and developments still under construction, reflecting a company built around an ongoing programme of mall-building rather than one-off projects. Operating from Clubview, Centurion, it works across the full development cycle, from site identification through construction to a completed retail centre.

Mdotc Solutions (M Dot C Solutions) is a 100% female-owned cleaning company registered in July 2018 by its founder, set up initially to provide cleaning and gardening services. The business has since grown to include general construction, holding a 4GB General Building grading, while keeping cleaning as its core service.

It operates in line with the Occupational Health and Safety Act, National Contract Cleaners Association standards and Construction Industry Development Board requirements, with health and safety protocols covering both staff and client sites, a focus the company sharpened further during the Covid-19 pandemic. Based in Kosmosdal, Centurion, it serves clients wanting a single contractor for cleaning, hygiene, gardening and smaller building projects.

Meat Ark is a butchery in Raslouw that was established in 1999, originally trading as EEZI Meats before adopting its current name. It prepares fresh beef, pork, lamb and chicken alongside a wide range of cold meats and other processed meat products, and offers delivery to customers who can't collect in person.

Customers single out the range of cold meats as a particular specialty, alongside the freshness of the counter meat more generally. Based in Raslouw AH, Centurion, and open daily except Tuesdays, from 8:30am to 5:30pm, it suits households doing a regular meat shop as well as customers after a specific cold-meat order.

This Rietondale practice specialises as a breast prosthetist and bra-fitting service, consulting with, measuring and fitting patients individually following mastectomy, lumpectomy and breast reconstruction surgery, rather than offering prostheses off a general shelf.

The practice is staffed by a registered lymphoedema therapist accredited with the Lymphoedema Association of South Africa, adding a specific clinical qualification relevant to patients managing lymphoedema as a result of breast cancer treatment or surgery. Based on Soutpansberg Road in Rietondale, Pretoria, it suits patients needing a dedicated, private fitting appointment for a post-surgical prosthesis or bra rather than a general pharmacy counter, and values being able to work through the process at an unhurried pace.

Miliswa M Group of Companies is a 100% Black woman-owned business operating four divisions from one head office: SHERQ (Safety, Health, Environment, Risk and Quality) consultancy, including contaminated site rehabilitation; events management for weddings, birthdays, baby and bridal showers, unveilings and corporate functions; a property practice connecting buyers and tenants with homes; and a waste management division.

Running several service lines from a single head office means a client already using the company for one division, such as SHERQ compliance work, can be referred to its events or property teams without starting a new search elsewhere. Based in Midstream Estate, Olifantsfontein, and open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, the group serves clients across safety consulting, events, property and waste management.

Moditi Holdings, based in The Reeds, Centurion, is a holding company operating through subsidiaries including Moditi Consulting Engineers and Moditi Properties, covering construction, property development and building services under one group structure.

The group runs its own corporate social investment programme and operates according to a stated B-BBEE policy, with a particular focus on creating opportunities for young South Africans in infrastructure development rather than only delivering projects for paying clients. Based in The Reeds, Centurion, it serves both private clients needing construction or property development work and young professionals looking to enter the infrastructure sector through the group's programmes.

Momentum Irene is a Momentum Financial Wellness Practice franchise established in 2018, giving clients access to the national Momentum brand's products through a locally based advisory team. It specialises in medical aid, short- and long-term insurance, investments, and pension and provident fund advice.

Its advisers bring more than 25 years of combined industry experience between them, which matters for clients wanting continuity of advice on long-term products such as retirement funds rather than a newly licensed adviser. Based in Irene, Centurion, the practice suits individuals and families wanting one local adviser team across medical aid, insurance and investment planning rather than separate specialists for each product.

items.reason: The commercial address is now confirmed independently: Suite 2-205, Block 2, Monument Office Park, 71 Steenbok Avenue, Monument Park, Pretoria 0181 is corroborated by current tenants (eKhaya Search, mCadastre and Rosema Bricks) listed at the same office park, so this is genuinely the Monument Office Park commercial building and not a mismatched address. However, no sufficiently authoritative source describing the office park's own facilities, services or property offering as a whole was found this round, so a proper description still cannot be written. IMPORTANT trap: monument-park.co.za must never be used as a source for this listing — it belongs to an unrelated residential apartment-rental business trading as 'Monument Park (Pty) Ltd' (apartment blocks such as Magnolia, Moepel and Maroela), not this commercial office park. Kept deferred pending a source describing the office park itself.

items.description:
MRT Marketing is a Pretoria-based marketing agency specialising in face-to-face and experiential marketing, running direct customer acquisition campaigns, brand activations and in-store promotions that put a brand in front of shoppers in malls, retail aisles and corporate events rather than only online. Its work is built around getting customers to experience a product directly, through staffed activations and distribution of flyers rather than a purely digital campaign.

The agency also runs short skills-training programmes in direct marketing aimed at unemployed youth, giving it a training and development role alongside its client campaign work. Based in Annlin, Pretoria, it suits brands wanting a hands-on, in-person activation campaign, and individuals looking to break into direct marketing through its training programmes rather than a classroom-only course.

Muhammad's Hardware CC started operating in 1993 transporting bricks, sand, stone and cement, before growing into a hardware store in Claudius selling tools, equipment and general building materials. The business later expanded into dry bulk tanker transportation, carrying goods locally within South Africa and cross-border into Mozambique, including Maputo.

Over the years, the company has built up a fleet of around 70 vehicles and a staff of more than 90 employees, giving it the transport capacity to move its own building material stock as well as bulk cargo for other companies. Based in Claudius, Centurion, it offers delivery, in-store pickup and same-day delivery, suiting both walk-in hardware customers and businesses needing bulk transport.

Multi Listing Services Pretoria, also known as MLS Gauteng North, is a non-profit company bringing together more than 50 real estate agencies in Pretoria North and Northeast to pool their property listings rather than compete on separate, overlapping portals.

Through the shared platform, buyers and tenants can search listings for sale and to let across suburbs including Montana Park, Montana Gardens, Sinoville and Doornpoort, while tools such as a bond calculator and property email alerts help with budgeting and tracking new listings. Based in Florauna, Pretoria, it suits buyers and sellers wanting to search listings from many agencies in one place rather than agency by agency.

Multi-Net Systems has built dedicated, specialist departments over more than 33 years in business, each covering a specific trade: automatic fire detection and protection, electronic access control, CCTV and IP surveillance, security and communication systems, heating, ventilation and air conditioning, and electrical installations.

The company holds ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certification along with OHSAS 18001, and positions its market focus across the public, private, commercial and industrial sectors rather than any single niche. Based in Pretoria Gardens, it serves clients needing one contractor to design, supply, install and maintain building safety and security systems rather than separate specialists for fire, security and HVAC.

MWare Automated Business Solutions has provided integrated software solutions since 2009 to industries including agriculture, mining, healthcare and retail, building systems around three core pillars: people management, asset management and stock management. Resource management, in the company's own framing, is the process of effectively, optimally and efficiently planning, scheduling and allocating a company's people, assets and stock rather than managing each in a separate spreadsheet.

Rather than selling a single off-the-shelf package, the company builds custom business process automation around what a specific client already uses, while drawing on global partner relationships to keep its solutions at an internationally benchmarked standard. Based in Irene, Centurion, it serves South African, broader African and international clients needing resource management systems tailored to their own operation rather than a generic ERP package.

MYCITO Business Management Solutions, founded in 2014, is a cloud-based provider of a learner management system and ERP-style services built for training providers and small businesses, letting a provider run everything from course administration to day-to-day business management inside one platform rather than several disconnected tools.

Its platform covers academy and learner-record management alongside dedicated portals for facilitators, assessors and moderators, letting a training provider run its accredited courses, track learner progress and manage compliance paperwork from one system rather than juggling spreadsheets and separate logins. Based in Highveld, Centurion, it suits training providers and smaller businesses needing a single cloud system for both learner administration and day-to-day business management rather than separate tools for each task.

Mzansi Improvements is a Level 2 B-BBEE construction and project-management company and the exclusive South African agent for CMTi machines, used in optical sorting technology such as XRT and XRF sorters as well as CMTi sweeping solutions and brake testers.

Its directors bring experience in problem-solving, crisis management and change management across construction, project management and mining, demonstrated on projects including the Wigwam Estate retirement development near Rustenburg and the conversion of an unused mine change house into a 200-bed Covid-19 field hospital for the Royal Bafokeng Platinum operation, carried out with the North West provincial health department. Based in Rietvalleirand, Pretoria, it serves clients needing project turnarounds and specialised mining or crisis-response solutions.

Netshield South Africa, established in 1994, is a Pretoria-based developer and manufacturer of IoT remote monitoring and control devices, delivering tailor-made end-to-end IoT and cloud-based solutions from the sensor through to the gateway and dashboard for clients across several industries.

Its product range extends into fibre connectivity equipment, SNMP-based network monitoring software and free-space optical wireless Ethernet links, alongside security and access control, power backup and communications solutions, making it as much an equipment manufacturer as a systems integrator. Based in Tijger Valley, Pretoria, it serves network operators, integrators and businesses needing locally designed IoT and connectivity hardware rather than only imported equipment bought off a shelf.

Nostalgic Pro Photography has covered weddings, portraits, family shoots, product, commercial and architectural photography, and sport photography for around 15 years, working from branches in both Johannesburg and Pretoria since the studio was established in April 2009.

Corporate clients have included MTN, Tile Africa, MICA Hardware, Lindt Chocolate and Deloitte, giving the studio a commercial photography portfolio alongside its wedding and family work, and a videography arm launched a few years after the studio itself to cover video alongside stills. Based in Brummeria, Pretoria, it focuses on a fast turnaround on editing, suiting clients who need finished images or video quickly after a shoot.

items.reason: Oasis Water is confirmed as a real purified-water retail franchise operating generally (reverse-osmosis purified water, 360+ outlets across South Africa, Botswana, Namibia, Eswatini and Lesotho), and other Pretoria outlets exist (Doornpoort, Annlin, Karenpark, Kilner Park, Villieria), but no reliable source specifically confirms the Express at Plastix outlet at 62 Baviaanspoort Road, East Lynne, or its current trading status and host-store relationship with Plastix. Those other Pretoria branches must not be used as evidence for this specific East Lynne outlet, so it stays deferred pending a source naming this branch directly.

items.description:
Oil Shoppe Gauteng is an official Shell Lubricants distributor in Montana Park, stocking engine oils, gear oils, greases, ATF and food-grade oils for motorcycles, cars, commercial vehicles, and agricultural and industrial machinery. Rather than simply selling off the shelf, the business visits client premises to run a detailed lube survey, including oil analysis by an independent laboratory, before recommending a lubrication plan.

With 35 years in the lubrication and maintenance solutions industry, it delivers warranted, OEM-approved products to the doorstep on the same day in the large majority of cases, and continues supporting clients after the sale rather than treating a delivery as the end of the relationship. Based in Montana Park, Pretoria, and open Monday to Thursday from 7am to 4:30pm, it suits fleet operators and industrial sites needing both expert product advice and reliable delivery.

Omega IT Solutions is a Centurion IT consulting and outsourcing company that has operated since 2003, now built around three core layers of coverage: Microsoft 365 setup, migration and licensing, managed identity threat detection and response covering account takeovers and business email compromise, and managed endpoint detection and response across laptops, desktops and servers.

With more than 20 years in business and over 50 years of combined team experience, the company backs its monitoring with human-led incident response rather than an alerts-only service, and continues to offer hardware and software sales, desktop and server support, and website design and hosting alongside its security services. Based in Doringkloof, Centurion, it suits businesses wanting one local provider for everyday IT support and ongoing cybersecurity monitoring.

ONE Insurance Underwriting Managers runs a regional office in Moreleta Park, Pretoria, providing underwriting and risk management across a wide spread of insurance lines, including transport, agriculture, commercial, personal, sectional title, fuel stations, education, hospitality and engineering risks, plus credit protection cover.

Founded in 1996, the underwriter is now part of the Old Mutual group, giving it the backing of a larger group while still underwriting specialised, sector-specific policies such as cover built around fuel stations or driving schools rather than only generic personal and business insurance. Based in Wingate Park, Pretoria, it serves brokers and clients needing underwriting across an unusually broad mix of niche and mainstream insurance sectors.

ooba Centurion is the Centurion branch of ooba, a South African home loan comparison service that submits a client's application to multiple banks, including their own, rather than leaving them to apply to each bank separately.

The service is free to the applicant, who receives a pre-approval certificate indicating an accurate affordability range before house-hunting, and then a set of competing quotes to compare once an offer is accepted on a property, rather than only one bank's rate to take or leave. Based in Eldoraigne, Centurion, it suits home buyers wanting to compare finance offers across banks through a single application rather than approaching each bank individually.

Penbro Kelnick has manufactured specialised electrical products in Pretoria since 1951, now holding ISO 9001:2015 certification and building to the EN15085 welding standard across more than seven decades in business. It supplies the railway, telecommunications, mining, petrochemical, utilities and industrial sectors with power resistors, transformers and magnetic products, UPS and standby power electronics, and custom AC and DC electrical panels.

As part of the internationally recognised Telema Group, the company combines local manufacturing with backing from an international group, and is trusted by end users, consulting engineers, system integrators and OEM partners whose projects specify its equipment for demanding environments. Based in Hermanstad, Pretoria West, it serves clients needing electrical equipment engineered for heavy industrial and infrastructure use rather than standard commercial-grade products.

Pious and Lloyd Engineering is a South African engineering consultancy whose work spans environmental management, geotechnical engineering, construction, water and geohydrology, and mining services for public and private sector clients. Its environmental team handles environmental impact assessments, atmospheric emission licence and water use licence applications, and environmental audits, while its geotechnical team carries out site investigations, foundation design and laboratory testing.

With more than ten years of experience and over 250 projects completed for more than 100 clients, the consultancy also runs groundwater monitoring, borehole drilling and yield testing, and takes on civil construction, refurbishment and infrastructure maintenance work. Based in the Tijger Vallei Office Park in Pretoria, it suits developers and public bodies needing environmental approvals and technical engineering input handled by a single consultancy.

Pirtek Pretoria is a hydraulic hose and fitting centre forming part of the Pirtek Africa network, specialising in hydraulic hoses and fittings, industrial hose and chemical transfer solutions, and hydraulic components. Its workshop covers powerpack manufacture and reconditioning, hydraulic-system troubleshooting, cylinder manufacture and reconditioning, lubrication systems, pneumatics, impulse tubing and stainless-steel solutions, alongside mobile hose and hydraulic call-out services.

Having traded in Pretoria for more than 20 years, the centre runs a fleet of five mobile vans staffed by technicians able to reach a site directly for a breakdown. It services the automotive, food and beverage, packaging, mining, construction and manufacturing industries across the Greater Tshwane area, extending to Brits, Bronkhorstspruit, KwaMhlanga, Cullinan and Centurion.

Based in Montana, Pretoria, it suits industrial and commercial operators needing both workshop-based hydraulic repairs and an on-site callout when a hose or hydraulic failure can't wait.

Podium at Menlyn is a five-storey, 4-Star Green Star-rated P-Grade office building at the entrance to Pretoria's Menlyn business node, directly opposite Menlyn Park Shopping Centre. The first phase of the development was completed on 31 March 2012, built around a corner site with a curved double-curtain performance-glazed facade flanked by exposed off-shutter concrete walls.

The L-shaped design shields the main entrance from the busy intersection it sits on, creating a sheltered courtyard rather than opening straight onto the road, while the facade was engineered for thermal comfort with low ongoing maintenance. Based in Alphen Park, Pretoria, the building offers tenants backup power, ample parking and round-the-clock security close to Menlyn Maine and Menlyn Virgin Active.

PostNet Groenkloof operates as a one-stop business centre in Groenkloof Plaza, offering copying and printing from A4 and A3 pages through to wide-format and plan printing, business cards, photo printing and name badges, alongside rubber stamps and everyday stationery.

The branch also runs domestic and international courier services, sells packaging material, and provides professional mailbox and digital business solutions for customers who need a registered business address or document service. Based on the corner of George Storrar Drive and Bronkhorst Street in Groenkloof, it is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 9am to 2pm, suiting both individuals posting a parcel and small businesses needing regular printing and courier support.

PostNet Wonderboom Junction is a business services outlet in the Wonderboom Junction centre in Annlin, offering printing and copying from A4 and A3 pages through to wide-format and plan printing, business cards, photo printing and name badges, alongside rubber stamps and everyday stationery.

The branch also handles packaging material and domestic and international courier bookings, giving small businesses a single counter for both document printing and sending parcels. Based in Wonderboom Junction on Lavender Road in Annlin, it trades Monday to Friday from 8am to 6pm, Saturdays from 9am to 5pm, and Sundays and public holidays from 9am to 3pm.

Premium Group SA is a plumbing and maintenance business based in Montana Park, offering general plumbing repairs, burst-geyser repairs, drain jetting and drain-camera inspections alongside electrical maintenance for homes, complexes, shops, offices, hotels and business parks across Gauteng.

Its everyday callouts range from bathtub and faucet installation, overflowing toilets and water filter cleaning through to pool pumps, heat pumps and basement or kitchen plumbing, and it also works directly with property management companies, handling the plumbing systems across multiple properties rather than only single households. With a 24/7 emergency service, it suits both individual homeowners with an urgent leak and property managers needing one contractor across several sites.

Prinmor Construction CC is a close corporation established in 1997 that has built around 35,000 low-cost housing units across Gauteng, North West and Mpumalanga, registered with the NHBRC and holding a Construction Industry Development Board grading of 5GB and 1CE.

That CIDB grading allows the company to tender for government-graded building and civil engineering contracts up to a set value, which matters for a contractor working mainly in subsidised housing delivery rather than private residential builds. Based in Doornpoort, Pretoria, it serves provincial and municipal housing programmes needing a contractor with an established delivery record at scale across multiple provinces.

Pro Admin, established in 1989, is a property-management company specialising in sectional title and Homeowners Association schemes, managing more than 19,000 units nationwide through more than 80 property professionals across four branches.

Alongside day-to-day financial and administrative management, the company runs smart water, electricity and gas metering for schemes, handling meter readings, invoicing, collection and remittance back to the scheme, and operates an in-house, licensed insurance brokerage offering scheme-specific and personal cover. It also provides sales and rental services, including tenant vetting, lease administration and rent collection. From Die Hoewes, Centurion, it serves community schemes and property owners wanting administration, utilities, insurance and rentals handled by one company.

Pro Link Hydraulics & Seals runs a fully equipped hydraulic workshop in Onderstepoort with its own pump test bench issued with a digital test certificate, offering direct counter sales of hydraulic hose, steel tube and fittings alongside aircon hose and fittings and FTF racing components.

Its workshop manufactures and repairs hydraulic cylinders, valve banks and power packs, including manufacture of cylinder components, pins and bushes and profiling work, and the team also carries out on-site line boring, cutting and welding of holes, pins and bushes, plus hydraulic system installation and repairs on trucks with load testing and inspection certificates. Open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5pm, it serves clients needing urgent breakdown call-outs as well as scheduled hydraulic workshop repairs.

QPS Signs, Design, Print, Display & Banners is a full-service sign, design and large-format print centre based in Centurion with more than 25 years of industry experience, handling everything from initial logo design through to finished signage for a new or established business.

Its range covers outdoor and indoor sign types from illuminated, fabricated and chromadek signs to pylon, billboard and directional signage, locally manufactured display stands, large-format digital, laser, litho and direct-to-substance UV printing, and embroidered, screen-printed or heat-pressed clothing branding. Open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 5pm and Fridays until 4:30pm, with delivery, in-store pickup and on-site installation options, it suits businesses wanting signage, print and branded clothing from a single supplier.

Rahabyte Digital Solutions SA develops custom web and mobile applications, e-commerce platforms and API integrations from East Lynne, Pretoria, with more than 15 years' experience across over 150 delivered projects for sectors including transportation, education, oil and gas, finance, agriculture, health and hospitality.

Beyond conventional app development, the company also builds crypto smart contracts and integrates crypto APIs for trading platforms, alongside its digital marketing, SEO and IT consulting work, giving it a reach into blockchain-related projects that a typical web development shop doesn't cover. Open Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm and Saturdays from 9am to 1pm, it suits businesses needing custom software built around a specific workflow rather than an off-the-shelf platform.

Reef Castor manufactures and distributes supermarket and industrial trolleys, castors, wheels and ladders from a 1,300-square-metre factory in Rosslyn it has operated since 2011, alongside a Durban branch, and offers full trolley repair and refurbishment for equipment nearing the end of its working life.

Because it manufactures its own range rather than importing and reselling trolleys, the company can personalise trolleys with CNC-cut identification plates and branded logos on the handles, and says it is the only manufacturer locally producing a complete range of supermarket and merchandise trolleys. Based in Rosslyn, Pretoria, it serves supermarkets and retailers needing new trolleys, customised branding, or the repair of an existing fleet.

Rosco Coach Builders is a vehicle conversion manufacturer in Koedoespoort, Pretoria, established in 2018 after branching out from an existing South African company, building box-body conversions and ICU and ILS ambulance conversions alongside response bakkie and response vehicle conversions.

Its conversions go to the South African Police Service, local and provincial traffic authorities, municipal fire and medical services, private medical services, and the construction, security and mining industries, with its own research and development unit keeping the designs current with new technology and equipment. Vehicles are manufactured to customer specification internationally, with final assembly and engineering carried out in South Africa. Based in Koedoespoort Industrial, it serves government, medical and private-sector fleets needing purpose-built emergency or response vehicles.

Rosema Bricks Head Office is the Monument Park, Pretoria sales office of a clay face-brick manufacturer that has traded since 1942, one of the longer-established brick producers still operating in the region.

The range includes Terracotta, Buff and Redwood finishes alongside specialty ranges such as Nala, Protea and Village Antique, giving builders and architects a choice between standard colours and more distinctive, textured finishes for a single project, with delivery arranged to building sites rather than requiring customers to collect. Based in Monument Office Park on Steenbok Avenue, it serves builders, architects and homeowners sourcing face brick for both standard and architecturally distinctive builds.

Rozewood is a property management company serving Homeowners Associations, body corporates and sectional title schemes, offering managing agent, executive managing administrator, compliance, financial management and maintenance-coordination services.

It is registered with the National Association of Managing Agents (NAMA) and the Property Practitioners Regulatory Authority (PPRA), and provides CSOS assistance for schemes dealing with disputes or compliance queries under the Community Schemes Ombud Service, support that matters most when a scheme's trustees are volunteers without specialist legal or financial training. Based in Wingate Park, Pretoria, it serves scheme trustees and homeowners associations wanting day-to-day administration, compliance and maintenance coordination handled by one appointed managing agent.

S.V Mahlangu Attorneys is a small law practice handling general litigation, including Road Accident Fund claims and personal injury cases, family law matters such as divorce and child custody, and insolvency law covering sequestrations and company liquidations.

The firm positions itself around a concentrated, hands-on approach rather than a large multi-department practice, aiming to maintain professionalism and efficiency across the range of fields it supports clients in rather than spreading itself across every area of law. Operating from Sunnyside, Pretoria, it serves individuals needing representation in litigation, family law or insolvency matters from a smaller practice rather than a large corporate law firm.

SA Accounting Network - Centurion is a local accounting practice operating within the broader SA Accounting Network, offering monthly bookkeeping, preparation of annual financial statements, income tax services, and VAT and PAYE registration and filing for small and medium businesses.

Beyond compliance work, the practice also offers business advisory services including restructuring and turnaround strategy, aimed at businesses in financial difficulty rather than only those needing routine monthly accounts. Operating from The Reeds, Centurion, as part of a network with partner accountants across South Africa's provinces, it suits business owners wanting both routine bookkeeping and more involved advice if the business runs into financial trouble.

SA Scaffold Group manufactures, sells and hires scaffolding from its Waltloo base, including Quickstage, Quicklock and aluminium systems, and also buys and sells second-hand scaffold and supplies formwork for concrete casting.

The company says it is currently the largest exporter of scaffold to Congo, Zimbabwe, Zambia, Malawi, Eswatini, Botswana and Mauritius, giving it a regional reach beyond the South African construction and mining projects it also supplies with qualified erectors and site managers. Based in Bergtuin, Pretoria, it suits contractors needing scaffold supplied, erected and later struck by the same company, as well as those simply wanting to buy or hire scaffold and formwork equipment.

SAR Electronic SA is an automation engineering firm with close ties to the German SAR Group, covering industrial process control and factory automation, environmental technology including cost-effective service and maintenance of photovoltaic plants, and building automation, combining German engineering standards with a locally based team.

Its brand-independent automation engineers approach each project on its own terms, offering hardware and software conceptual design and development, equipment procurement, cabinet building, installation, system programming, skills transfer, and ongoing process control and system service and maintenance. Based in Montana Park, Pretoria, it serves industrial sites and solar plant operators needing automation designed and supported locally rather than through a single-brand equipment supplier.

Securitas Financial Group is an independent financial-services provider operating since 1989, offering life, short-term, business and medical insurance brokering, alongside wealth and investment advice from its Boardwalk Office Park branch in Faerie Glen, Pretoria.

Its fiduciary services team assists with drafting wills, estate planning and the administration of deceased estates, while a separate employee benefits division provides consulting services to employers and their staff, giving the practice a reach beyond everyday personal insurance into longer-term financial and estate planning. Based in Faerie Glen, it serves individuals, families and businesses wanting insurance, investment and estate planning advice from one independent broker rather than a single insurer's in-house advisers.

Seebo Group CC, established in 2009 and 100% Black-owned, is a plant and equipment hire and mining services company that also trades in wholesale fuel supply and exploration drilling, operating across six South African provinces from its Magalieskruin base.

Running plant hire, fuel supply and exploration drilling under one group lets mining and construction clients source several project needs from a single supplier rather than coordinating separate contractors for equipment, fuel and drilling work. Based in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, and open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, it serves mining and construction clients needing equipment, fuel or drilling services across multiple provinces.

Seeff Pretoria East has operated from Pretoria's property landscape since 1996, handling residential, commercial, industrial and holiday-letting property sales and rentals across Pretoria East suburbs including Arcadia, Garsfontein, Lynnwood and Moreleta Park.

The branch was recognised for the most units sold nationally for five consecutive years from 2018 to 2022, and its team of around 55 agents, many with more than ten years' experience in the area, sells sole mandate properties in about 43 days on average by sharing listings and working as a team rather than agents competing individually. Based in Selati Park, Alphen Park, it suits sellers wanting a larger, established agency team covering most Pretoria East suburbs.

Sensory FX is a Centurion-based fragrance and flavour manufacturer developing custom scents and tastes for FMCG food, beverage, household and personal-care brands across Southern, East and West Africa, tailoring each formulation to a specific product rather than selling from a fixed catalogue of stock scents.

The company is certified to FSSC 22000 food safety standards alongside ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001, covering quality, environmental and occupational health and safety management, which matters for brand owners needing a fragrance or flavour supplier able to pass their own food-safety audits. Based in Bronberrik, Centurion, it serves FMCG brand owners across the region needing a custom-developed scent or flavour rather than a generic, off-the-shelf fragrance house.
